title: Attributed conversation, visitor custody, reference provenance and final material joins
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: historical continuation / reference provenance / integration evidence scope
reviews.disposition:
Historical five-intent continuation under AD36/AD42/AD43. All five deep intents remained separate after the failed fold test. The planned university withdrawal, promised Monday start and planned dinner are not completed actions, appointments or paid meals. Rozanne's guesses, reported path counts and unknown ranks stay attributed rather than world truth; spoken basics/dream/meeting knowledge differs from private reasons. The actual Daly meeting and inferred rank remain distinct. Twelve banknotes as fact/knowledge with no modeled denomination must not be counted as another cash grant; the recorded2883 balance is unchanged.

Preserve all five withholding/later-reader rows. An open fact without a named scheduled consumer remains open, not silently complete. First-act location is the existing stairs and movement is an effect; the held visit then supports the hall interaction. The original quiet result and no freeze do not prove general actor scheduling. One seeded KJ3I route on the copied KJ3E bundle and literal import support the stated continuation, not dirty shared dist or a fresh complete campaign. No14/21 px captures were taken; no visual-floor proof follows from headless execution. Civil clock and human play are untested.

PF13 still is not a speedup finding. Four pre-write content-cap failures are distinct from one successful native route; a pre-scan is a requested lint idea, not implemented merely because it appears under Next. Keep the200-character cap as this pack's existing format, not a universal prose-length rule. The copied final bundle identity is historical evidence, not an instruction that a temporary folder remains available or should serve every future proof. This content review adds no source/shard, pack, browser or current build verification.
reviews.evidence: Fresh full content read. KJ3J/B complete individually combined; reference/coverage output truncated centrally, recovered reference final9 lines and coverage1–19. All35 coverage rows and acceptance status read.
reviews.reopen: Retain concrete source/consumer/proof distinctions; reopen against a named current input or meaningful changed dependency.

reviews.classification: historical continuation / reference provenance / integration evidence scope
reviews.disposition:
Historical18-stage visitor continuation and repaired presentation under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve B1's chapter/continuity windows and the explicit inferred storage bridge: same gun/five rounds move from the older coat checkpoint to the source-supported drawer before retrieval, without rewriting the old save or creating a second weapon. Authored search/concealment weighting is not a stochastic detection probability or a general investigative/legal engine. A warning, an expert's attributed two-day promise and an acknowledged account are not automatic arrest, an actual expert examination or a scheduled appointment.

Existing actor bodies, settled arrival/visit/departure, physical custody and recipient knowledge are different owners. The visit holds an itinerary without resurrecting missing actors or reconstructing memory; admission and settlement require actual recipients. The concrete UI defect was false re-admission blockers for participants already reserved by that same pending job. Matching the actual job command and showing remaining work/Stop repairs that projection while preserving genuine unrelated-job blockers and native settlement. Navigation does not grant knowledge or silently activate Stop.

The route bundle and final presentation bundle share a recorded pack, with changed commandId projection/pure consumer separately exercised by three final checks. Ten native route groups across18 earned stages are not a final-bundle full-route replay, fresh opening-to-ch10 proof or exhaustive source coverage. The stopped superseded suite is excluded; final4921/4921 retains its actual input identity and overlapping focused checks are not added. MCP sampled startup rather than independently playing the full visit. Old preview/PID and private copied assets are not current installed/delivered state.

The49 prior plus18 new stages describe action inventory, not a novel completion percentage. Later source qualification, firearm integration, ordinary starts, procedural careers, purse accounting and combat remain their distinct gaps. Human review is optional. This review reads the full receipt, not private source/pack/test saves/screenshots, current source or logs; it renews no runtime proof or old worker reservation.

reviews.classification: historical continuation / reference provenance / integration evidence scope
reviews.disposition:
Retained reference/provenance map, not an implementation specification, under AD32 and source/evidence rules. All table rows, bounded source windows, trial notes and round2 additions were read. Preserve distinctions among retained whole files, selected semantic spans, inspected images, captions, backup tables, exact constructors and source consumers. Six Taiwu images contain four detailed visual reads plus two caption-documented images. Nine encyclopedia tables are not decoded runtime rows. Twelve ACS matching inputs and inherited P01–P35/Y traces do not establish a fresh whole managed-code pass or native Mac access. Timestamped walkthrough captions are attributed observations, not independent code.

Tale formula/furnace/herb/skill fields retain original spellings and unresolved referenced interpreters; counts of168/42/70/171/1456/10/24 records are inventories, not complete semantic coverage or current-build equivalence. effectType alone does not establish elemental meaning. TownRefine service data is not automatically the player's resolver. HP mixed-edition/OCR prepared windows and source hashes retain their scope; the first-round MoL lead was inherited, while round2 extracted110 members and records explicit read windows rather than implying every generated target window was read. Author-hosted Warbreaker pages and official Ryza documentation are retained/selected evidence, not whole-page semantic or interactive gameplay proof.

Round2's1160 unique constructor rows preserve unevaluated C# expressions; validation of arity/positions is not execution of a decoded interpreter. Full copied BuildingDomain/helpers retain reused versus fresh span distinctions. Modded Yaogui screenshots remain separate from vanilla. Failed Minecraft raw-page preservation remains failure despite successful web reading; missing old Noita extraction does not become a new native/source pass through a public digest. The private archive, source snapshots and ignore record preserve provenance and secrecy without making public assets or current ownership authority.

Later native trial suggestions require their then available supported environment/profile/input identity and do not authorize install, acquisition or foreground launch now. Existing payloads/backup tables are distinct from playable access. This full index review inspects no raw archive, source class, book passage, image, executable or private save. Retain the useful original alternatives and concrete report links with their unresolved source/native limits rather than deleting the index or treating catalog counts as closed mechanics.

reviews.classification: historical continuation / reference provenance / integration evidence scope
reviews.disposition:
Full35-identifier integration-map review under AD36/AD42/AD43: PC27–PC43, F1–F8, MF1–MF5, A9–A12 and J1 retain source-local meanings and primary M1–M6/paired joins. Keep native IDs/cohorts versus derived-from relationships, typed basis/unit/resolution/omission contracts versus invented conversions, physical allocation versus observed recommendations, and unknown/unsupported/zero versus exhaustive physical impossibility. Char identity does not inherit raw-wood behavior from its parent. Local HP/LOTM/native laws and the directional ORIGINAL abrasion adapter are distinct from symbolic characteristic substitution or a global chemistry/rune system.

The final I5 same-bundle import/quantity/blend/use/refusal result is later proof in this ledger, so old dependency notes elsewhere must not continue calling that selected join universally absent. Paid preparation, support histories, deadlines, retained method conditions, dose/stock and downstream grade readers are separately scoped claims. Native Goat4 supplies320 toward300 with20 expected loss uses fixed-batch metadata, not physical mass conversion. Fine/coarse60/30-minute use and20-minute suspension are selected local consumers, not universal work rates. Old missing terms remain unknown rather than fabricated retained history.

Performance samples and supported-chain maximum5914 key bytes/depth3 are descriptive bounded measurements, not worst-case proof of arbitrary repeated treatments. Native32 fits versus budget8 incomplete keeps search coverage explicit. Unsupported units fail before a zero budget can conceal authoring error. Known-view cache skipping/selection invalidation and disclosure-purity checks do not authorize hidden truth or add a new cache/DAG/index. More schema sophistication has no selected consumer here.

The full shared command exited1 with3452/3456 and four missing fixture dependencies. Exact supplementation plus14/14 affected-file recovery does not turn that original full command green or establish a second full rerun. Keep I6's evidence-based closure and its exact bundle/input digest alongside that qualification. The35 resolved identifiers and no selected playable gate describe these consumers, not all materials/worlds or current source proof. Four file roundtrips and observed native UI are the recorded fixtures' evidence; this document review does not rerun them or inspect linked M6/I5 JSON. No installation/publication or new universal system follows.
